decisions.reason: Changing the hero visual to a template-based picture using the LOTCLIP link does not change the established hero headline.
The selected form of one hero image does not change the landing page content mix, specification source, or optional screenshot-selection rule.
The source selects how to create a specific hero asset but does not alter the site's clean minimal SaaS style, style reference, or brand palette source.
The hero asset instruction does not affect the Webflow platform or hosting-plan choice.
